versions.subject: netsupport (#3798)
versions.detection:

EventCode=7

  "*\\CryptPak.dll",
  "*\\HTCTL32.DLL",
  "*\\pcicapi.dll",
  "*\\pcichek.dll",
  "*\\PCICL32.DLL",
  "*\\TCCTL32.DLL"
